detectors.description:
Reentrancy in RwaStockBuyer._acquire(address,uint256,uint256,bytes) (src/RwaStockBuyer.sol#215-224):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- IStockSwapAdapter(adapter).buy{value: ethIn}(token,stockVault,minUnits,routeData) (src/RwaStockBuyer.sol#220)
	Balance read before the call:
	- beforeBalance = IERC20(token).balanceOf(stockVault) (src/RwaStockBuyer.sol#219)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- afterBalance < beforeBalance || afterBalance - beforeBalance < minUnits (src/RwaStockBuyer.sol#222)
		- stale variable `beforeBalance`
